title: PlayStation Offers $40 Off PS5 Refurb Bundles Ahead of GTA 6
description: PlayStation is offering a $40 discount on refurbished PS5 and DualSense controller bundles, helping players save up to $155 ahead of GTA 6.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Hardware Upgrades in Focus Ahead of Major Releases

As the gaming community continues to look ahead to the release of *GTA 6*, hardware availability and pricing remain top of mind for players wanting to upgrade their setups. According to a recent report by IGN, PlayStation is currently offering a notable hardware promotion focusing on refurbished PlayStation 5 consoles.

Specifically, PlayStation is offering $40 off when customers purchase a refurbished PS5 console and a DualSense wireless controller together. This bundle promotion delivers up to $155 in total savings compared to purchasing brand-new components separately. For gamers looking to step into the current generation of hardware without paying full retail price, this bundled discount provides a cost-effective alternative.

## Market Context and Hardware Readiness

While the promotional announcement from the source material does not explicitly mention software tie-ins, industry observers often note that hardware manufacturers frequently roll out discounts and bundle deals leading up to major industry milestones and blockbuster launches like *GTA 6*. Lowering the entry barrier for current-gen hardware helps expand the console install base, preparing the market for the demanding technical requirements of upcoming AAA titles.

Opting for manufacturer-certified refurbished hardware gives budget-conscious consumers a reliable way to secure a console with official backing, making the path to upgrading a bit easier on the wallet.

## Editor's Take

Preparing your gaming setup for a massive release like *GTA 6* doesn't always require buying everything brand new at full price. PlayStation's current $40 discount on refurbished PS5 and controller bundles offers a smart, budget-friendly way to jump into current-gen gaming and save up to $155 in the process.
